ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Хозяин» (khozyain) and «работник» (rabotnik) are 'master' and 'workman', as elsewhere in this translation; Lichtenberg's «поступать по правде» (postupat' po pravde) is 'to act rightly'. Pronouns for God stay lowercase, as in the Russian.
Source observation: [14]–[15] the Angelus Silesius saying and its attribution are printed as plain paragraphs, not as a quotation like section 3; kept as printed
